ruling: R32 (Drew, 2026-09-14, "SPLIT MOVES") + R55 (Drew, 2026-09-15, "the title may not name more than the destination"): a split-identity row (cardId != hobbyiqCardId) moves to the checklist-backed side ONLY when the title names that side's differing segment(s) on the ONE axis (or combination of axes) the row was actually judged on -- setKey, cardNumber, parallel, sport, printRun. Report-only wave (apply-improve scope=r32, no apply path exists for this scope).
reportOnlyUntil: REPORT ONLY until a steward dispatches it. The lane writes only under BACKFILL_APPLY=true. This scope currently has NO apply path in rematch-sold-comps.cjs (parseApplyScope permanently refuses "split"/"r32" from writing) -- this list is the vehicle Drew's ruling names for actually moving the rows the wave judged move-worthy.
finding: The R32 wave (32 slots dispatched 2026-09-15 ~23:53-23:56Z, apply-improve scope=r32) judged 1,107,317 HIQ-SPLIT rows: would-move 17,313 (1.56%), would-park 1,090,004 (98.44%). This list is built from the wave's own moveSamples arrays (splitIdentity.scopes.split.byAxis.<axis>.moveSamples in each slot's census-slot-N.json artifact), NOT from the console-log capture the steward saved to $S/r32-wave-would-move-2026-09-16.md + .jsonl -- those files carry the generic split-identity SAMPLE lines (id/class/cardId||hobbyiqCardId/differing-segments) for ALL derivation classes, not the R32-specific move verdict, and the console log never prints moveSamples/parkSamples at all (only the aggregate per-axis move/park counts) -- the SPLIT SCOPE artifact JSON was the only place the real move samples existed.
coverageNote: Of the 32 dispatched slots, 18 had completed and uploaded their census-slot-N.json artifact at the time this list was built (the remaining 14 were still running, part of the same runner queue as the concurrent R33 wave): slots 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 17, 20, 22, 23, 24, 29. Recovered-slot totals: move=12,941, park=973,587 (a row is tallied once per judged axis, so this total double-counts rows judged on more than one axis -- 1,419 is the correct DISTINCT-ROW count). This list is necessarily a SUBSET of the wave's full 17,313 would-move population -- the other 14 slots' move samples are not yet recoverable and are NOT represented here. A follow-up append is owed once those slots finish and their artifacts can be pulled the same way.
refusalRule: A row refuses (is excluded from this list) when its fromCardId/fromHobbyiqCardId differ on any segment OUTSIDE the row's own judged-axis set (read from the row's own `reason` string, title-names-destination:<dest>:<axis1,axis2,...> -- the authoritative source, since the fleet's per-axis moveSamples arrays are independently capped at 50 each and a row's SAMPLE can land in fewer axis buckets than it was actually judged on). auto/cardYear/grade differences are never in scope for R32 (AXES_THIS_SCOPE_JUDGES = setKey/cardNumber/parallel/sport/printRun only) and are excluded from the refusal check accordingly. 0 of 1,419 candidate rows were refused by this rule -- every row's real slug diff, re-measured directly from fromCardId/fromHobbyiqCardId, stayed within its own judged axes.
pointReadVerification: 200-row evenly-spread sample (every ~7th entry) point-read by id+partitionKey=fromCardId against the live sold_comps container: 200/200 still resident at fromCardId, 200/200 with hobbyiqCardId unchanged from the census's own capture (0 moved-away, 0 not-found, 0 hobbyiqCardId-since-changed).
shapeNote: destination="cardId" in the wave's own verdict means the row's OWN cardId (partition) is the checklist-backed side -- shape="repoint" here, no partition change, only hobbyiqCardId is patched to match. destination="hobbyiqCardId" means the row's hobbyiqCardId is checklist-backed -- shape="relocate", the partition (cardId) moves to match hobbyiqCardId, which itself stays unchanged.
